description: This Java class provides Cucumber step definitions for the login feature of the OrangeHRM application. It maps Gherkin steps to code that interacts with the login page via Selenium WebDriver, using the Page Object pattern. The class includes step implementations for navigation, inputting credentials, actions like clicking login, and verification of successful or failed login outcomes.

classes.name: LoginStepDefinitions
classes.description: Contains step definitions for login-related scenarios, including navigation, credential input, login action, and verification.

methods.name: LoginStepDefinitions
methods.description: Constructor that initializes WebDriver and LoginPage instances.

methods.name: iNavigateToTheOrangeHRMLoginPage
methods.description: Navigates to the login page using URL from configuration.

methods.name: iEnterAnInvalidUsername
methods.description: Enters an invalid username provided as parameter.

methods.name: iEnterAnInvalidPassword
methods.description: Enters an invalid password provided as parameter.

methods.name: iClickTheLoginButton
methods.description: Clicks the login button to submit the form.

methods.name: iShouldBeRedirectedToTheDashboardPage
methods.description: Asserts that the current URL indicates successful login.

methods.name: iShouldSeeTheDashboardHeader
methods.description: Asserts that the dashboard header is visible, indicating successful login.

methods.name: thePageUrlShouldContain
methods.description: Checks that the current URL contains the expected fragment.

methods.name: iShouldSeeAnErrorMessage
methods.description: Verifies the presence of an expected error message on failed login.

methods.name: iShouldSeeARequiredFieldValidationMessage
methods.description: Verifies that validation messages for empty required fields are displayed.
